name: Portainer
description: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes and networks from a web page.
notes: Open it within 5 minutes of installing and create the admin user (at least 12 characters), as Portainer requires. It asks for a setup token: Logs shows it on the line with setup_token=. Your browser warns about Portainer's self-signed certificate the first time. Portainer has full control of Docker, including the apps installed here.
